en.headline: SFC says HKEX will consult this quarter on longer cash hours
en.dek: Julia Leung said longer trading would start in derivatives, with a cash-market discussion paper due in the fourth quarter.
body: The Securities and Futures Commission expects Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing to publish a discussion paper this quarter on extending cash-market trading hours, chief executive Julia Leung said on Friday.

Speaking at an Asia Securities Industry and Financial Markets Association forum, Leung said work on longer securities trading hours would be introduced first in the derivatives market. She said that would help investors respond to moves across time zones and keep Hong Kong competitive.

She said longer hours could later sit alongside other measures still under study, including tokenised money and digital Hong Kong dollar settlement arrangements, so that investors could adjust positions and manage risk against newer market information. The exchange would welcome views when the cash-market paper is issued.

Leung also said the commission would keep working on capital efficiency, market microstructure and a liquidity ecosystem. Local reports said cross-market margin arrangements between clearing houses were among the next items under study.

zh.headline: 證監會：港交所今季就延長現貨時段發討論文件
zh.dek: 梁鳳儀在亞洲證券業論壇稱，延長交易時段會先在衍生產品市場推行，現貨市場文件於第四季發表。
body: 證監會行政總裁梁鳳儀周五表示，香港交易所會於今季就延長現貨市場交易時段發表討論文件。
她在亞洲證券業與金融市場協會論壇上說，研究中的延長證券交易時段會率先在衍生產品市場推行，以便投資者應對跨時區的市場變化，並維持香港的競爭優勢。
梁鳳儀表示，延長時段長遠可配合其他仍在研究的安排，包括代幣化貨幣及數碼港元結算，讓投資者按較新的市場資訊調整倉位及管理風險。她說，現貨市場討論文件發表後歡迎各方提出意見。
她又指，證監會會繼續在提升資本效率、改革市場微觀結構及構建流動性生態圈三方面着手。本地報道稱，結算所之間的跨市場保證金安排是下一步研究重點之一。
